Gigabyte A520M K V2 (rev. 1.1) AMD AM4 Micro-ATX Motherboard

Secure a reliable and ultra-budget-friendly foundation for your next PC build with the Gigabyte A520M K V2 (rev. 1.1) Micro-ATX Motherboard. Available at Turbo Computer, this efficient AMD AM4 socket motherboard delivers optimized support for AMD Ryzen 5000 Series, 4000 G-Series, and 3000 Series processors. It stands as the definitive hardware choice for budget-conscious gamers, internet cafés, and office workstations across Egypt requiring dependable everyday stability and excellent performance tracking.

The Gigabyte A520M K V2 (rev. 1.1) is smartly engineered with a durable digital VRM solution to ensure consistent power distribution to your Ryzen CPU. It comes equipped with a high-speed NVMe PCIe 3.0 x4 M.2 slot for rapid SSD boot times, alongside a Realtek Gigabit LAN chip featuring automated bandwidth management for smooth online gaming and browsing. Complete with Anti-Sulfur design for long-term component hardware modification protection, High-Quality Audio Capacitors for immersive sound, and Smart Fan 5 cooling controls, it offers unbeatable value.
